key.name: backend-instances
key.description: Array of (backend_id, backend_type) tuples for configured backends. Each instance has settings stored at /org/ronny-pfannschmidt/gtkpass/backends/{backend_id}/

key.name: search-as-you-type
key.description: Enable live search filtering as user types.

key.name: clipboard-timeout
key.description: Seconds before automatically clearing clipboard. 0 to disable.

key.name: auto-lock-timeout
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before auto-locking. 0 to disable.

key.name: display-name
key.summary: User-visible name for this backend instance
key.description: Name shown in the sidebar. If empty, a name is derived from the backend type.

key.name: custom-data-path
key.description: Path to custom demo.json file. If empty, uses built-in demo data.
